jobs.title: Builder Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Guidde

Guidde is an AI digital adoption platform that serves as the creation and consumption hub for modern organizations. Founded in 2020 by seasoned entrepreneurs, we use generative AI to transform workflows into rich, multi-format documentation in minutes. Our platform helps teams scale knowledge across employees, customers, and even AI systems, turning everyday processes into instant, in-app video guiddes that live where work actually happens.

More than 5,000 organizations worldwide, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, rely on Guidde to reduce support load, accelerate onboarding, and make knowledge accessible on demand.

We’re building the future of knowledge creation, sharing, and experience.

The Ideal "Guidder" is like our platform - clear, impactful, and focused on delivering value. We blend a startup environment with sports team principles - strategic in planning, collaborative in execution, and obsessed with customer wins. We value doers who listen more than they talk and who show up ready to play their best game. Ready to make your mark on our roster? Go Guidde!

If you are a product leader who takes full ownership, sets direction, sweats the details, loves to create, and is driven to build experiences that people genuinely love using, then your place is with us!

What will you do?

- Own Guidde’s core creation experience – Define vision and roadmap for the capture-and-edit flow that sits at the heart of the product

- Design seamless cross-platform journeys – Improve the creation experience across Chrome extension, desktop, and web, removing friction at every step

- Stay deeply connected to users – Run interviews, feedback sessions, and continuous discovery to understand real user needs and behaviors

- Turn data into decisions – Define success metrics, track performance, and use insights to guide fast, confident product decisions

- Leverage AI where it adds real value – Identify where intelligent capabilities improve the experience and bring them into production effectively

- Lead cross-functional execution – Work closely with engineering, design, and GTM teams to deliver high-impact product outcomes

What will you need to have?

- 5+ years of product management experience – Owning product areas end-to-end, from strategy through execution and iteration

- Startup DNA – You've built in a small, fast-moving team where ownership was real, pace was high, and you wore multiple hats

- Enterprise experience – You've built for or sold to enterprise customers and understand the unique constraints and expectations that come with it

- Strong user-centric mindset – Consistent experience conducting research and validating decisions through real user interactions

- Engineering proximity – You came from a technical background or have spent meaningful time working hand-in-hand with large R&D teams

- Experience building AI-powered features – You can describe a concrete, tangible example of something you built or shipped using AI — not a generic answer, but a real deliverable

Bonus points if you have:

- A technical background - you came from engineering or spent meaningful time working closely with a large R&D team

- Experience building creation tools, productivity products, or user workflows

- Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) motion

Your journey with Guidde

Leave Your Mark: Own and shape the core experience that defines Guidde’s product
Work Your Way (Hybrid): Enjoy a flexible work arrangement based in Tel Aviv
Innovate Together: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, and GTM teams on a product used globally
Fuel Your Growth: Grow into a senior product leadership role as the company scales
Your Value Matters: Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and are enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.
